content: Mobile lightbox pinch-zoom best practice: Pointer Events API (pointerdown/move/up) unifies mouse/touch/pen; track pointers in a Map, two-pointer distance ratio = scale, midpoint = zoom origin; setPointerCapture keeps events when fingers leave; touch-action:none on the zoom stage so the browser does not hijack gestures (keep it OFF the backdrop if native scroll wanted); apply transform: translate() scale() via rAF with will-change:transform; single pointer = pan, two = pinch, lock mode per gesture; clamp scale and pan to bounds. Libraries exist (react-quick-pinch-zoom, yet-another-react-lightbox zoom plugin, react-photo-view) but render their own portal/chrome — they replace rather than integrate with an existing Base UI Dialog.
